_comment: The six real readings the LipidLog calculator was validated against, per
LipidLog-CC-handoff.md. These are the ground truth: every other test in
this suite proves the code is self-consistent, but only these prove it
Add one object per reading. 'input' is the raw stored reading exactly as
the app would hold it (tc, hdl, tg, ldl, source, apobMeasured). 'expect'
lists only the derived fields you want pinned — any subset of nonHDL,
tcHdl, tgHdl, ldlFried, ldlMH, ldlDelta, apob, apobLabel.
The suite skips this check while the list is empty and says so in its
output, so an empty file can never look like a pass.
